item.title: CVE-2026-127223 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | GFI HelpDesk before 4.99.13 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the staff group management feature that allows authenticated attackers with administrator privileges to execute arbitrary SQL queries by supplying a crafted title parameter to /admin/index.php?/Base/StaffGroup/InsertSubmit. The Controller_StaffGroup.RunChecks() method concatenates the unsanitized title value directly into a duplicate name lookup query against the staffgroup table, allowing attackers to read or modify database contents.

item.title: CVE-2026-127224 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | GFI HelpDesk before 4.99.13 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the archiver export feature that allows authenticated attackers with administrator privileges to execute arbitrary SQL queries by supplying crafted itemid[] array values to /admin/index.php?/archiver/Manager/ExportAll. The Controller_Manager.ExportAll() method joins the itemid values with implode() and GetWhere() concatenates them into an IN() clause without sanitization or parameterization, and DumpTables() executes the resulting query against each ticket-related table, allowing attackers to read or modify database contents.

item.title: CVE-2026-134010 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1 | odf-kit is a TypeScript and JavaScript library for working with OpenDocument Format files. In versions 0.9.8 through 0.14.1, the odsToHtml() renderer inserts document-controlled cell formatting and row height values into HTML style attributes without escaping them. An attacker can craft an ODS file that injects arbitrary HTML attributes or elements, allowing JavaScript execution in the host page's origin when an application inserts the converted output as HTML. This issue is fixed in version 0.14.2.

item.title: CVE-2026-135079 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.0
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.0 | A vulnerability was found in vijaythapa333 django-student-management-system up to 0d96e62cc4e996e3e77bec1b8e3da3980edf8889. Affected by this issue is the function student_profile_update of the file StudentViews.py of the component Student Profile Update. The manipulation of the argument first_name results in cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been made public and could be used. This product utilizes a rolling release system for continuous delivery, and as such, version information for affected or updated releases is not disclosed. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

item.title: CVE-2026-135428 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Automura for Gravity Forms – Webhooks & REST API for Automation before 1.0.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in Rest_Admin::serve_file() on the global rest_pre_serve_request filter.
